title: Vanishing density of M in the cone X_{1/2}(TₓM^⊥, x) at an approximate tangent point (Simon Ch. 3, Remark 1.5(3), formula (6))
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ with n ≥ 1, M ⊆ ℝ^P with Hⁿ(M) < ∞ (Hⁿ = μHE[n]), x ∈ ℝ^P and Q a linear subspace of ℝ^P which is the approximate tangent space of M at x (SimonGMT HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x Q). Let X(x) := {z ∈ ℝ^P : 2|p_Q(z − x)| < |z − x|}, p_Q the orthogonal projection onto Q (this is Simon's cone X_{1/2}(Q^⊥, x) in the form (2), since dist(v, Q^⊥) = |p_Q v|). Then for every t ∈ (0, ∞] there is ρ₀ > 0 such that Hⁿ(M ∩ X(x) ∩ B_ρ(x)) ≤ t ρⁿ for all 0 < ρ < ρ₀.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (M : Set (Euclid P)) (x : Euclid P) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), 0 < n → μHE[n] M ≠ ∞ → HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x Q → ∀ t : ℝ≥0∞, 0 < t → ∀ᶠ ρ in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ), μHE[n] (M ∩ ({z | 2 * ‖Q.starProjection (z - x)‖ < ‖z - x‖} ∩ ball x ρ)) ≤ t * ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ n)
